title: Kenyan Vegetable Stir Fry
description: A simple and healthy Kenyan-inspired vegetable stir fry made with a variety of colorful vegetables.

ingredients.name: Kenyan vegetables (such as tomatoes, bell peppers, and onions)
Stir-fry oil (such as vegetable or canola oil)

instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the sliced vegetables and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the spinach leaves and stir-fry for another minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
